features.name: Gradio app launch
features.detail: gr.Blocks app on server_name 0.0.0.0 port 7862, queue max_size=2, show_error=True, allowed_paths=[outputs/], Soft theme (Inter font). UTF-8 stdout reconfigured at import. No QI /health,/version,/info endpoints — pure Gradio UI.

features.name: Detached launcher
features.detail: Kills any listener on 7862 (Get-NetTCPConnection -> Stop-Process), then Popen avatar_studio.py DETACHED_PROCESS | CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP, logs to logs/studio.log, verifies the port is listening, tails the log on failure.

features.name: In-UI Kill & Restart
features.detail: Spawns a detached python -c helper that sleeps 1.5s, taskkills the current PID, then relaunches avatar_studio.py with DETACHED_PROCESS. Returns a status string to the red Step-4 button.

features.name: QI_AvatarStudio NSSM service
features.detail: Self-elevating .bat installs NSSM service QI_AvatarStudio via C:\QIH\engine\bin\nssm.exe; AppDirectory C:\1-AI\APPS\AvatarStudio, runs .venv python avatar_studio.py, Start=SERVICE_DEMAND_START, rotating log logs/service.log. Not registered in QI_Service_Registry.md.

features.name: CLI pipeline launcher
features.detail: argparse CLI: agent + text|@script.txt, --no-tts. Kokoro TTS (step_tts) -> Hallo2 via WSL2 (step_hallo2) -> MP4. Standalone path independent of the Gradio app, driven by run_avatar.bat.

features.name: Studio config load/save
features.detail: Merges studio_config.json over _DEFAULT_CONFIG (cloud_apis heygen/did, open_source musetalk/sadtalker/wav2lip) + preserves ui_prefs. save_studio_config deep-copies and blanks cloud api_key fields before writing JSON (indent=2, ensure_ascii=False).

features.name: Secret overlay (keys out of repo)
features.detail: Reads secrets/avatarstudio.env (KEY=VALUE lines), env vars override the file. _SECRET_MAP {did:DID_API_KEY, heygen:HEYGEN_API_KEY} injects keys into cfg['cloud_apis'][prov]['api_key'] at runtime only; never persisted.

features.name: Dynamic engine choices
features.detail: Always offers LivePortrait + Hallo2; appends HeyGen/D-ID only when both api_key and enabled are set, and MuseTalk/SadTalker/Wav2Lip when enabled. Last engine saved to ui_prefs.render_engine, validated against current choices.

features.name: Agents / languages / voice catalog
features.detail: agents.json (4 agents w/ voice, photo, language_voice_overrides); languages.json (10 langs: lang_code, engine, gender voices, status); VOICE_CATALOG ~60 voices x Women/Men/Girls/Boys x language. rembg import guarded by REMBG_AVAILABLE.

features.name: Voice resolution
features.detail: Priority: explicit UI voice_override > agent language_voice_overrides (kokoro only) > languages.json gender default. edge-tts voices always taken from languages.json unless overridden. Returns (voice, lang_code).

features.name: Voice generation (dual engine)
features.detail: engine from languages.json. edge-tts: async edge_tts.Communicate(rate=+N%, pitch=+Nst).save(wav). Kokoro: KPipeline(lang_code), iterate audio chunks, np.concatenate, sf.write @24000Hz, optional pitch post-shift. Returns (wav_path, duration).

features.name: Pitch shift (Kokoro)
features.detail: scipy.signal.resample by factor 2**(semitones/12) then resample back to original length to preserve duration. Used only for Kokoro (edge-tts applies pitch natively via SSML).

features.name: CLI Kokoro TTS step
features.detail: Standalone Kokoro KPipeline path for the CLI: concatenates samples, writes <agent>_voice.wav at agents.json kokoro.sample_rate (24000), reports duration.

features.name: LivePortrait (motion transfer)
features.detail: WSL2: cd LP_DIR && LP_PYTHON inference.py -s <portrait> -d <driving.mp4> with animation_region, driving_option/multiplier, scale, vx/vy, and relative/pasteback/stitching/crop flags. find first non-concat .mp4, cp to Windows, ffmpeg-mux the WAV, cleanup /tmp.

features.name: Hallo2 (audio-driven)
features.detail: WSL2: HALLO_PYTHON scripts/inference_long.py --config long.yaml --source_image --driving_audio with pose/face/lip weights + face_expand_ratio. Patches inference_steps/cfg_scale into a /tmp yaml via sed when non-default. timeout=3600. Slow (~15-30 min/min audio).

features.name: video-retalking (lip-sync)
features.detail: WSL2 post-process on any rendered mp4: export retalking env PATH+CUDA_HOME, cd video-retalking, inference.py --face <mp4> --audio <wav> --outfile. timeout=3600. Opt-in via apply_retalking checkbox; numpy 2.x / basicsr / dlib patches applied in WSL2.

features.name: D-ID cloud
features.detail: Basic-auth flow: POST /images, POST /audios, POST /talks (audio script, fluent), poll /talks/{id} up to 120x5s until done, stream-download result_url. Enabled in config; no key configured.

features.name: HeyGen cloud
features.detail: X-Api-Key flow: upload image + audio assets, POST /v2/video/generate (talking_photo + audio, 720x1280), poll video_status.get, download video_url. Disabled (no key).

features.name: MuseTalk / SadTalker / Wav2Lip
features.detail: WSL2 conda-env subprocess wrappers reading open_source config; each raises if not enabled. MuseTalk -m scripts.inference; SadTalker inference.py --still --preprocess full; Wav2Lip inference.py --checkpoint wav2lip_gan.pth. All disabled pending WSL2 install.

features.name: Full pipeline generator
features.detail: Generator yielding (audio, video, status) after each step. Validates per-language scripts, resolves portrait (custom_photo or agent_photo_path), applies background once, loops selected languages: TTS -> engine dispatch (Hallo2/HeyGen/D-ID/MuseTalk/SadTalker/Wav2Lip/LivePortrait) -> optional retalking. Per-language slug + timestamp file stems.

features.name: Background prep
features.detail: Modes: Original photo (passthrough), Describe (Phase 2 passthrough), Solid color (hex -> RGBA fill), Upload background image (resize composite). rembg cutout -> PIL alpha_composite -> temp JPEG in outputs/. Falls back to source if REMBG unavailable.

features.name: WSL path translation
features.detail: Converts C:\path -> /mnt/c/path (drive-letter aware), optional shell-quoting. Used for every portrait/audio/video handed to WSL2 ffmpeg and the render engines.

features.name: Portrait helpers (OpenCV)
features.detail: ffprobe duration; ffmpeg single-frame extract; OpenCV Haar face/eye cascades + Laplacian sharpness to score sampled frames; PIL ImageGrab region capture. All ffmpeg/ffprobe calls run in WSL2.

features.name: Audio mux into render
features.detail: ffmpeg -i <video> -i <wav> -c:v copy -c:a aac -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -shortest -> final mp4. Hallo2 deliberately replaces its embedded audio with our WAV so the rendered script is heard verbatim.

features.name: Scene concatenation
features.detail: Concatenates per-scene mp4s into one movie via ffmpeg concat. Part of the Scene movie pipeline (run_pipeline).

features.name: ffmpeg runtime
features.detail: imageio-ffmpeg==0.6.0 available in the Windows venv; the actual mux/probe/extract commands run against ffmpeg/ffprobe inside WSL2 Ubuntu-24.04 via subprocess.

features.name: Script splitting
features.detail: Three modes: manual (--- breaks, optional [Name] / [Name:photo] tags), ai (NEXUS LLM split), hybrid (LLM split then user-editable). Falls to rule-based splitter when AI unavailable.

features.name: Character model
features.detail: characters.json roster independent of agents.json; merges agents as a convenience. Resolves a per-scene photo by slug or inline path. SceneData dataclass carries text/char/timing.

features.name: Scene render + assemble
features.detail: Per-scene TTS -> avatar render -> optional retalking, then concat_scenes into the final movie. run_pipeline is a generator yielding (log, final_mp4, scene_rows) wired to the Scene tab's sp_render_btn.

features.name: Smoke test (liveness)
features.detail: pytest module; skips when :7862 unreachable; asserts the Gradio root serves HTTP 200. Deliberately avoids importing app modules or triggering heavy WSL2 renders.

features.name: Language / routing tests
features.detail: Validate 10-language voice routing (Kokoro vs edge-tts), engine selection, and edge-tts output. smoke_test.py prints the supported-language table.

features.name: Diagnostic dump
features.detail: diagnose.py collects env, WSL2, and config state for paste-back debugging; check_syntax.py syntax-checks avatar_studio.py.
